patterns.message: Server-only package. npm workspaces hoist express and @prisma/client into the root node_modules, so these import cleanly from src/ and then ship a server package to the browser. Reach the server over HTTP through src/services/http.ts instead.
zod schemas are a separate export path so the validation library stays out of the client bundle. Import types from '@ai-travel/shared'; keep client-side form checks hand-written.
